  let xyz : G := xy ◇ z

  let wx : G := w ◇ x

  let a13 : G := (a6 ◇ xw) ◇ p
  let a14 : G := ((xw ◇ a6) ◇ a13) ◇ y
  let a15 : G := a14 ◇ (a13 ◇ (xw ◇ a6))
  let a30 : G := (a6 ◇ a18) ◇ p
  have hx : x = p := h x w a6
  have hxw : xw = a18 := h xw a6 wx
  have hp : p = ((a18 ◇ a6) ◇ a13) := h p (a6 ◇ xw) a6
